stem.text: Bacteria that infect skin wounds can become resistant to the antibiotic commonly used to kill them.
Which statement explains how these bacteria could become resistant to the antibiotic?

A.text: Exposure to the antibiotic causes a change in the bacterial cell wall, preventing the antibiotic from working.

B.text: Other bacteria that normally protect the skin against infection are killed by the antibiotic, allowing the infectious bacteria to survive.

C.text: Random mutations in DNA allow some of the bacteria to survive in the presence of the antibiotic.

D.text: The antibiotic causes the bacterial DNA to mutate, allowing the bacteria to survive in the presence of the antibiotic.
